lines.label: Tax K3 (GST on air transport)
lines.basis: DGCA-CAR-S3-M-II — Statutory taxes and airport charges are refundable on cancellation, non-utilisation or no-show, INCLUDING on promotional and special fares where the basic fare is non-refundable. Obligation attaches to the operating permit (Rule 133A of the Aircraft Rules, 1937), not to fare filing, so it binds this carrier regardless of PSS.

lines.basis: YQ/YR are carrier-imposed, not statutory taxes. Their refundability follows the fare rule, which is not retrievable for this ticket.
